raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that the Free Software Foundation had two founders, Richard Stallman and Robert J. Chassell, conflating Chassell’s role as a founding director/treasurer with being a founder. Authoritative sources indicate FSF was founded by Richard Stallman; this misinterpretation introduced the erroneous co-founder claim.
